A FEW WAYS IN

About this experiment

Move your cursor to look between layers of floating architecture. Arrow keys wander through the depth, scroll to approach, and Parallax changes how strongly the layers separate. Space swaps the sky.

Everything is generated here, in your browser. No image files, no recordings, no two moments quite alike.
